2026-10-07 lane classical-misc: arms cut from 16 to 5 (4 singles + combined). The four controls touch disjoint kernels/workloads: SHARED_PREP = holtwinters parallel estimate (more:ets); SERIES4 = holtwinters serial estimate arm only (frequency+5 > 64; reached by no board workload); FORECAST4 = sequence seq_kernel (theta family, damped-ets); TEAM_MIB = team_kernel budget (garch, prophet; no effect below ~300 series). No pair shares a kernel on a workload, so the 11 combos measured nothing the singles do not.
